data.one_liner: Official lint rules for development when using the bloc state management library.
data.what_it_does: Provides official static analysis lint rules specifically designed for applications using the bloc state management library. It helps enforce best practices, naming conventions, and architectural constraints across your codebase.
use_when: You are developing a Flutter or Dart application using the bloc or cubit state management library.
You want to enforce consistent architecture and style guidelines across a team working with blocs.
avoid_when: Your project does not use the bloc or cubit state management library.
You prefer general-purpose lints and do not want bloc-specific architectural restrictions.
strengths: Provides official rules directly from the creators of the bloc library.
Includes recommended rules sets that can be easily included in your analysis_options.yaml.
weaknesses: Strictly tied to the bloc ecosystem.
Limited utility outside of bloc-based architectures.
data.setup_notes: Add the dev dependency and include package:bloc_lint/recommended.yaml in your analysis_options.yaml.
